title: VoiceVeritas: open-source read-speech detection for interview anti-cheating
description: VoiceVeritas is an open-source, audio-only system that estimates the probability an interview answer was read or recited from a script rather than spoken spontaneously. It ships two complementary tracks: an interpretable prosodic baseline (34 handcrafted features + LightGBM with feature attribution) and a frozen wav2vec 2.0 embedding head, plus median ensembles, SNR-aware reliability warnings, and a full robustness suite (noise/telephony/compression stress tests). The benchmark, its cross-domain caveats, and the honest failure modes are documented in-repo, including a held-out SBCSAE domain-shift evaluation and per-utterance prediction artifacts for auditing.
notes: Trained-model weights and manifests inherit their training-data licenses (LibriSpeech CC BY 4.0, AMI CC BY 4.0, SBCSAE CC BY-ND 3.0 US — eval-only).
